name: amply
description: Artists host their own music, set their own prices, and are paid directly.

scripts.build: npm run build:node && npm run build:manage
scripts.check: npm run build && node spec/validate.mjs spec/example.json && npm --prefix node run typecheck && npm --prefix relay run typecheck
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build && ./node/node_modules/.bin/wrangler pages deploy site --project-name=amply
